id-20261030-news-2.title: Middle-Class Purchasing Power and Dwindling Savings: Reading Household Spending Patterns Toward the Year-End

segments.src: Menjelang akhir tahun, perbincangan tentang melemahnya daya beli kelas menengah kembali ramai.
segments.tr: As the end of the year approaches, discussions about the weakening purchasing power of the middle class are resurfacing.

segments.src: Ada yang mengatakan warga kelas menengah makin sering menunda belanja, mengurangi makan di luar, dan menguras tabungan untuk menutup kebutuhan sehari-hari.
segments.tr: Some say that the middle class is increasingly delaying spending, reducing dining out, and draining savings to cover daily needs.

segments.src: Namun, apakah klaim itu benar-benar didukung data?
segments.tr: However, is that claim really supported by data?

segments.src: Artikel ini membahas indikator yang bisa dipakai untuk menilainya dan langkah praktis mengatur keuangan keluarga.
segments.tr: This article discusses indicators that can be used to assess it and practical steps for managing family finances.

segments.src: *Catatan: artikel ini bersifat informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan atau investasi pribadi.*
segments.tr: *Note: this article is for general information only, not personal financial or investment advice.*

segments.src: ## Siapa yang Dimaksud "Kelas Menengah"?
segments.tr: ## Who is Meant by the "Middle Class"?

segments.src: Istilah ini sering dipakai longgar.
segments.tr: This term is often used loosely.

segments.src: Bank Dunia dan Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) memakai pendekatan berbeda, misalnya berdasarkan rentang pengeluaran per kapita per bulan.
segments.tr: The World Bank and the Central Statistics Agency (BPS) use different approaches, for example based on the range of expenditure per capita per month.

segments.src: Karena definisinya berbeda, angka jumlah kelas menengah di satu laporan bisa tidak sama dengan laporan lain.
segments.tr: Because the definitions differ, the number of middle-class people in one report may not be the same as in another.

segments.src: Sebelum menilai sebuah klaim, periksa dulu:
segments.tr: Before assessing a claim, first check:

segments.src: - Definisi kelas menengah yang dipakai (pengeluaran, pendapatan, atau pendidikan).
segments.tr: - The definition of the middle class used (expenditure, income, or education).

segments.src: - Periode data dan sumbernya.
segments.tr: - The data period and its source.

segments.src: - Apakah angka merujuk pada rumah tangga atau individu.
segments.tr: - Whether the figures refer to households or individuals.

segments.src: ## Data yang Bisa Dipakai untuk Menilai Klaim
segments.tr: ## Data That Can Be Used to Assess Claims

segments.src: Satu angka tidak cukup untuk menyimpulkan.
segments.tr: One figure is not enough to draw a conclusion.

segments.src: Beberapa indikator berikut sebaiknya dibaca bersamaan.
segments.tr: Several of the following indicators should be read together.

segments.src: ### 1. Inflasi dan komponennya
segments.tr: ### 1. Inflation and its components

segments.src: Inflasi umum bisa tampak rendah, tetapi rumah tangga merasakan harga kebutuhan pokok, transportasi, dan biaya sekolah.
segments.tr: General inflation may appear low, but households feel the prices of basic necessities, transportation, and school fees.

segments.src: Bandingkan inflasi inti dan inflasi kelompok makanan yang dirilis BPS dengan kenaikan pendapatan Anda sendiri.
segments.tr: Compare the core inflation and food group inflation released by BPS with your own income growth.

segments.src: ### 2. Penjualan ritel dan konsumsi rumah tangga
segments.tr: ### 2. Retail sales and household consumption

segments.src: Survei Penjualan Eceran Bank Indonesia serta komponen konsumsi rumah tangga dalam Produk Domestik Bruto menunjukkan arah belanja secara agregat.
segments.tr: The Bank Indonesia Retail Sales Survey and the household consumption component in the Gross Domestic Product show the direction of spending in aggregate.

segments.src: Perlambatan yang berlangsung beberapa kuartal berturut-turut lebih bermakna daripada fluktuasi satu bulan.
segments.tr: A slowdown that lasts for several consecutive quarters is more meaningful than a one-month fluctuation.

segments.src: ### 3. Indeks Keyakinan Konsumen
segments.tr: ### 3. Consumer Confidence Index

segments.src: Survei Konsumen Bank Indonesia mengukur persepsi terhadap kondisi ekonomi, penghasilan, dan rencana pembelian barang tahan lama.
segments.tr: The Bank Indonesia Consumer Survey measures perceptions of economic conditions, income, and plans to purchase durable goods.

segments.src: Angka di atas 100 menandakan optimisme, di bawahnya pesimisme.
segments.tr: A figure above 100 indicates optimism, below it pessimism.

segments.src: Persepsi tidak selalu sama dengan perilaku, tetapi bisa menjadi sinyal awal.
segments.tr: Perception is not always the same as behavior, but it can be an early signal.

segments.src: ### 4. Tabungan dan simpanan
segments.tr: ### 4. Savings and deposits

segments.src: Data Lembaga Penjamin Simpanan (LPS) dan Bank Indonesia memperlihatkan distribusi simpanan menurut nominal rekening.
segments.tr: Data from the Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation (LPS) and Bank Indonesia show the distribution of deposits by account nominal.

segments.src: Jika rekening bernominal kecil dan menengah tumbuh lambat atau saldonya turun, itu petunjuk tekanan.
segments.tr: If small and medium-nominal accounts grow slowly or their balances drop, that is a sign of pressure.

segments.src: Namun hati-hati: data ini tidak selalu memisahkan pemilik rekening menurut kelas sosial.
segments.tr: But be careful: this data does not always separate account holders by social class.

segments.src: ### 5. Pergeseran pola belanja
segments.tr: ### 5. Shifts in spending patterns

segments.src: Perhatikan juga perubahan perilaku, seperti beralih ke merek yang lebih murah, membeli kemasan lebih kecil, memakai cicilan atau paylater lebih sering, atau menunda pembelian barang besar.
segments.tr: Also pay attention to behavioral changes, such as switching to cheaper brands, buying smaller packaging, using installments or paylater more often, or delaying the purchase of large items.

segments.src: Data pembiayaan konsumen dan rasio kredit bermasalah membantu melihat apakah cicilan mulai memberatkan.
segments.tr: Consumer financing data and non-performing loan ratios help see if installments are starting to become burdensome.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Perlu Diwaspadai Saat Membaca Klaim
segments.tr: ## Things to Watch Out for When Reading Claims

segments.src: - **Korelasi bukan sebab.** Penjualan yang turun bisa disebabkan musim, perubahan kebiasaan belanja ke platform daring, atau faktor harga, bukan semata melemahnya daya beli.
segments.tr: - **Correlation is not causation.** Declining sales can be caused by the season, changes in shopping habits to online platforms, or price factors, not solely by weakening purchasing power.

segments.src: - **Rata-rata menyembunyikan sebaran.** Kelompok berpenghasilan tinggi bisa menopang angka agregat sementara kelompok menengah tertekan.
segments.tr: - **Averages hide distribution.** High-income groups can prop up aggregate figures while the middle group is under pressure.

segments.src: - **Anekdot bukan statistik.** Antrean sepi di satu pusat perbelanjaan tidak mewakili seluruh negeri.
segments.tr: - **Anecdotes are not statistics.** Empty queues at one shopping center do not represent the entire country.

segments.src: - **Data direvisi.** Angka awal sering diperbarui; periksa rilis terbaru.
segments.tr: - **Data is revised.** Initial figures are often updated; check the latest release.

segments.src: Kesimpulan yang adil biasanya berbunyi: ada tanda-tanda tekanan pada sebagian rumah tangga, tetapi tingkat keparahannya bergantung pada indikator, wilayah, dan kelompok pendapatan.
segments.tr: A fair conclusion usually reads: there are signs of pressure on some households, but the severity depends on the indicator, region, and income group.

segments.src: ## Langkah Realistis Mengatur Keuangan Keluarga
segments.tr: ## Realistic Steps to Manage Family Finances

segments.src: Terlepas dari perdebatan data, ada hal yang bisa Anda kendalikan.
segments.tr: Regardless of the data debate, there are things you can control.

segments.src: 1. **Catat arus kas selama sebulan penuh.** Kelompokkan pengeluaran menjadi wajib (cicilan, listrik, pangan, sekolah), penting, dan keinginan.
segments.tr: 1. **Record cash flow for a full month.** Group expenses into mandatory (installments, electricity, food, school), important, and wants.

segments.src: 2. **Tetapkan prioritas dana darurat.** Targetkan secara bertahap setara tiga sampai enam bulan pengeluaran. Jika terasa berat, mulai dari satu bulan.
segments.tr: 2. **Set emergency fund priorities.** Gradually target the equivalent of three to six months of expenses. If it feels heavy, start with one month.

segments.src: 3. **Hitung rasio cicilan.** Banyak perencana keuangan menyarankan total cicilan tidak melebihi sekitar 30% dari penghasilan. Jika lebih, pertimbangkan melunasi utang berbunga tertinggi lebih dulu.
segments.tr: 3. **Calculate the installment ratio.** Many financial planners suggest that total installments do not exceed about 30% of income. If more, consider paying off the highest-interest debt first.

segments.src: 4. **Siapkan anggaran khusus akhir tahun.** Liburan, hadiah, dan diskon besar mudah memicu belanja impulsif. Tentukan batas nominal dan daftar belanja sebelum membuka aplikasi.
segments.tr: 4. **Prepare a special year-end budget.** Holidays, gifts, and big discounts easily trigger impulsive spending. Determine a nominal limit and a shopping list before opening the app.

segments.src: 5. **Bandingkan harga dan manfaatkan promo dengan selektif.** Diskon hanya menguntungkan jika barangnya memang dibutuhkan.
segments.tr: 5. **Compare prices and use promos selectively.** Discounts are only profitable if the item is actually needed.

segments.src: 6. **Otomatiskan menabung.** Pindahkan sebagian gaji ke rekening terpisah di hari gajian, sebelum dipakai untuk hal lain.
segments.tr: 6. **Automate savings.** Move a portion of your salary to a separate account on payday, before it is used for other things.

segments.src: 7. **Tinjau proteksi.** Pastikan asuransi kesehatan atau jaminan sosial aktif agar satu kejadian tak langsung menggerus tabungan.
segments.tr: 7. **Review protection.** Ensure health insurance or social security is active so that one incident does not immediately drain savings.

segments.src: 8. **Cari tambahan penghasilan secara hati-hati.** Waspadai tawaran keuntungan cepat dan pinjaman daring ilegal. Periksa legalitas lembaga di situs Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK).
segments.tr: 8. **Seek additional income carefully.** Beware of offers of quick profits and illegal online loans. Check the legality of the institution on the Financial Services Authority (OJK) website.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Klaim bahwa kelas menengah menahan belanja dan menggerus tabungan patut diperhatikan, tetapi perlu diuji dengan data yang beragam dan sumber yang jelas.
segments.tr: The claim that the middle class is holding back spending and draining savings is worth noting, but it needs to be tested with diverse data and clear sources.

segments.src: Bagi keluarga, kabar baiknya adalah disiplin sederhana, seperti mencatat pengeluaran, menjaga cicilan, dan menabung otomatis, tetap efektif di tengah ketidakpastian harga.
segments.tr: For families, the good news is that simple discipline, such as recording expenses, maintaining installments, and saving automatically, remains effective amidst price uncertainty.

segments.src: Untuk keputusan keuangan yang besar, konsultasikan dengan perencana keuangan berlisensi.
segments.tr: For major financial decisions, consult with a licensed financial planner.

id-20261030-news-3.title: Layoffs (PHK) and JKP: Rights Workers Can Claim, Requirements, and Common Mistakes

segments.src: Kabar pemutusan hubungan kerja (PHK) di sejumlah sektor membuat banyak pekerja bertanya-tanya: apa saja yang berhak saya terima?
segments.tr: News of layoffs (PHK) in several sectors has made many workers wonder: what am I entitled to receive?

segments.src: Dalam praktiknya, banyak orang hanya fokus pada pesangon, padahal ada beberapa hak lain yang berjalan di jalur berbeda, yaitu **Jaminan Kehilangan Pekerjaan (JKP)** dan **Jaminan Hari Tua (JHT)** dari BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: In practice, many people only focus on severance pay, even though there are several other rights running on different tracks, namely **Job Loss Guarantee (JKP)** and **Old Age Guarantee (JHT)** from BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum gambaran umum, syarat, alur klaim, dan kesalahan yang kerap terjadi.
segments.tr: This article summarizes the general overview, requirements, claim flow, and frequent mistakes.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Isi artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat hukum. Besaran manfaat, batas upah, dan prosedur dapat berubah mengikuti regulasi dan kebijakan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. Selalu periksa informasi terbaru di kanal resmi sebelum mengajukan klaim.
segments.tr: > **Note:** The contents of this article are for general information and not legal advice. Benefit amounts, wage limits, and procedures may change according to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan regulations and policies. Always check the latest information on official channels before filing a claim.

segments.src: ## Tiga Hak yang Berbeda, Tiga Jalur yang Berbeda
segments.tr: ## Three Different Rights, Three Different Tracks

segments.src: Ketiga hak berikut sering tercampur.
segments.tr: The following three rights are often confused.

segments.src: Padahal sumber dan cara mengurusnya tidak sama.
segments.tr: In fact, their sources and how to manage them are not the same.

segments.src: | Hak | Sumber | Siapa yang memproses |
segments.tr: | Right | Source | Who processes |

segments.src: | Pesangon dan hak lain dari perusahaan (uang penghargaan masa kerja, uang penggantian hak) | Perusahaan, sesuai UU Ketenagakerjaan dan peraturan turunannya | Perusahaan dan pekerja (bisa melalui perundingan) |
segments.tr: | Severance pay and other rights from the company (long service award money, rights replacement money) | Company, according to the Manpower Law and its implementing regulations | Company and worker (can be through negotiation) |

segments.src: | JKP | Program BPJS Ketenagakerjaan | Pekerja mengajukan klaim langsung ke BPJS Ketenagakerjaan |
segments.tr: | JKP | BPJS Ketenagakerjaan Program | Worker files a claim directly to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan |

segments.src: | JHT | Tabungan hari tua dari iuran pekerja dan pemberi kerja | Pekerja mengajukan klaim ke BPJS Ketenagakerjaan |
segments.tr: | JHT | Old age savings from worker and employer contributions | Worker files a claim to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan |

segments.src: Poin pentingnya: **JKP dan JHT tidak menggantikan pesangon.** Pekerja yang memenuhi syarat dapat menerima ketiganya, sebab sumber dananya berbeda.
segments.tr: The important point: **JKP and JHT do not replace severance pay.** Eligible workers can receive all three, because the sources of funds are different.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu JKP?
segments.tr: ## What is JKP?

segments.src: JKP adalah jaminan sosial bagi pekerja yang kehilangan pekerjaan akibat PHK.
segments.tr: JKP is social security for workers who lose their jobs due to layoffs.

segments.src: Manfaatnya terdiri dari tiga hal:
segments.tr: Its benefits consist of three things:

segments.src: 1. **Uang tunai** yang diberikan secara bertahap selama jangka waktu tertentu.
segments.tr: 1. **Cash** provided gradually over a certain period.

segments.src: 2. **Akses informasi pasar kerja**, misalnya lowongan dan bimbingan jabatan.
segments.tr: **Access to labor market information**, such as vacancies and job guidance.

segments.src: 3. **Pelatihan kerja** untuk meningkatkan atau mengubah keahlian.
segments.tr: 3. **Job training** to improve or change skills.

segments.src: Berdasarkan aturan yang berlaku saat ini, manfaat uang tunai dihitung sebagai persentase dari upah yang dilaporkan ke BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, dengan batas upah tertentu.
segments.tr: Based on current rules, cash benefits are calculated as a percentage of wages reported to BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, with certain wage limits.

segments.src: Ketentuan ini pernah diperbarui, sehingga pekerja perlu memastikan angka dan lama pemberian terbaru lewat kanal resmi BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: This provision has been updated, so workers need to ensure the latest figures and duration through official BPJS Ketenagakerjaan channels.

segments.src: ## Syarat Umum Penerima JKP
segments.tr: ## General Requirements for JKP Recipients

segments.src: Secara garis besar, pekerja perlu memenuhi hal-hal berikut:
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, workers need to fulfill the following:

segments.src: - Warga negara Indonesia.
segments.tr: - Indonesian citizen.

segments.src: - Terdaftar sebagai peserta program jaminan sosial ketenagakerjaan, termasuk program JKP, dan status kepesertaannya aktif.
segments.tr: - Registered as a participant in the manpower social security program, including the JKP program, and membership status is active.

segments.src: - Memenuhi masa iuran minimum, yaitu pernah membayar iuran dalam jangka waktu tertentu sebelum PHK dan tidak menunggak pada periode terakhir sebelum PHK.
segments.tr: - Meet the minimum contribution period, which is having paid contributions for a certain period before the layoff and not being in arrears in the last period before the layoff.

segments.src: - Mengalami PHK yang termasuk dalam kategori yang dijamin.
segments.tr: - Experiencing a layoff included in the guaranteed category.

segments.src: - Belum bekerja kembali saat mengajukan klaim dan tetap dalam status mencari pekerjaan.
segments.tr: - Not yet re-employed when filing a claim and remaining in job-seeking status.

segments.src: Tidak semua jenis berakhirnya hubungan kerja masuk kategori JKP.
segments.tr: Not all types of employment termination fall into the JKP category.

segments.src: Pekerja yang mengundurkan diri atas kemauan sendiri, pensiun, mengalami cacat total tetap, atau meninggal dunia umumnya tidak termasuk.
segments.tr: Workers who resign of their own volition, retire, experience permanent total disability, or pass away are generally not included.

segments.src: Karena itu, **alasan PHK yang tertulis dalam dokumen sangat menentukan.**
segments.tr: Therefore, **the reason for the layoff written in the document is very determining.**

segments.src: ## Alur Klaim JKP Secara Umum
segments.tr: ## General JKP Claim Flow

segments.src: 1. **Pastikan status kepesertaan.** Cek apakah Anda terdaftar dalam program JKP dan apakah iuran dibayarkan rutin. Pengecekan dapat dilakukan lewat aplikasi atau situs resmi BPJS Ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: 1. **Check membership status.** Check if you are registered in the JKP program and if contributions are paid regularly. Checking can be done through the BPJS Ketenagakerjaan application or official website.

segments.src: 2. **Pastikan perusahaan melaporkan PHK.** Pemberi kerja memiliki kewajiban memberi tahu BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. Jika tidak dilaporkan, proses klaim bisa tertunda.
segments.tr: 2. **Ensure the company reports the layoff.** Employers have an obligation to notify BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. If not reported, the claim process can be delayed.

segments.src: 3. **Kumpulkan dokumen.** Biasanya mencakup identitas diri, surat PHK atau dokumen yang menjelaskan alasan PHK, data kepesertaan, dan nomor rekening atas nama sendiri.
segments.tr: 3. **Gather documents.** Usually includes self-identity, layoff letter or document explaining the reason for layoff, membership data, and account number in your own name.

segments.src: 4. **Ajukan klaim secara daring** melalui kanal resmi BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, atau melalui kantor cabang bila diperlukan.
segments.tr: 4. **Submit claims online** through official BPJS Ketenagakerjaan channels, or through branch offices if necessary.

segments.src: 5. **Ikuti verifikasi.** BPJS Ketenagakerjaan akan memeriksa data. Selama menerima manfaat, penerima diminta tetap aktif mencari kerja dan mengikuti ketentuan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: 5. **Follow verification.** BPJS Ketenagakerjaan will check the data. While receiving benefits, recipients are asked to remain active in job hunting and follow applicable regulations.

segments.src: Ada batas waktu pengajuan setelah tanggal PHK.
segments.tr: There is a submission deadline after the layoff date.

segments.src: Jangan menunda, sebab klaim yang diajukan melewati batas waktu dapat ditolak.
segments.tr: Do not delay, because claims submitted past the deadline can be rejected.

segments.src: ## JHT: Bisakah Dicairkan Setelah PHK?
segments.tr: ## JHT: Can It Be Disbursed After a Layoff?

segments.src: Peserta yang terkena PHK pada umumnya dapat mengajukan pencairan JHT tanpa menunggu usia pensiun, dengan melampirkan dokumen yang diminta, misalnya bukti PHK atau surat keterangan berhenti bekerja.
segments.tr: Participants affected by layoffs can generally apply for JHT disbursement without waiting for retirement age, by attaching requested documents, such as proof of layoff or a certificate of cessation of work.

segments.src: Perlu diingat bahwa pencairan JHT berarti mengambil tabungan hari tua.
segments.tr: Keep in mind that JHT disbursement means withdrawing old age savings.

segments.src: Pertimbangkan kebutuhan jangka panjang sebelum mencairkan seluruhnya.
segments.tr: Consider long-term needs before withdrawing it all.

segments.src: ## Pesangon: Hak yang Dihitung dari Masa Kerja
segments.tr: ## Severance Pay: Rights Calculated from Length of Service

segments.src: Besaran pesangon bergantung pada masa kerja, alasan PHK, dan ketentuan yang berlaku, termasuk peraturan pelaksana UU Cipta Kerja.
segments.tr: The amount of severance pay depends on length of service, reason for layoff, and applicable provisions, including implementing regulations of the Job Creation Law.

segments.src: Komponen yang lazim dibahas:
segments.tr: Components commonly discussed:

segments.src: - **Uang pesangon**
segments.tr: - **Severance pay**

segments.src: - **Uang penghargaan masa kerja**
segments.tr: - **Long service award money**

segments.src: - **Uang penggantian hak**, misalnya cuti tahunan yang belum diambil
segments.tr: - **Rights replacement money**, for example un-taken annual leave

segments.src: Jika perusahaan menawarkan angka yang berbeda dari perhitungan Anda, mintalah rincian tertulis.
segments.tr: If the company offers a different figure from your calculation, ask for a written breakdown.

segments.src: Perundingan bipartit, mediasi dinas ketenagakerjaan, atau pendampingan serikat pekerja adalah jalur yang bisa ditempuh sebelum sengketa dibawa lebih jauh.
segments.tr: Bipartite negotiations, manpower office mediation, or labor union assistance are paths that can be taken before disputes are taken further.

segments.src: ## Kesalahan yang Sering Terjadi
segments.tr: ## Common Mistakes

segments.src: - **Menandatangani dokumen tanpa membaca.** Surat pengunduran diri atau pernyataan "tidak menuntut" dapat memengaruhi hak pesangon dan syarat JKP. Baca isinya dan minta salinan.
segments.tr: - **Signing documents without reading.** Resignation letters or "no claim" statements can affect severance rights and JKP requirements. Read the contents and ask for a copy.

segments.src: - **Mengira JKP otomatis cair.** Klaim harus diajukan sendiri oleh pekerja.
segments.tr: - **Thinking JKP is automatically disbursed.** Claims must be filed by the worker themselves.

segments.src: - **Menunggak atau tidak tahu status iuran.** Cek status kepesertaan sebelum ada kabar PHK, bukan sesudahnya.
segments.tr: - **Being in arrears or not knowing contribution status.** Check membership status before news of layoffs, not after.

segments.src: - **Alasan PHK ditulis sebagai "mengundurkan diri".** Pastikan dokumen mencerminkan kondisi sebenarnya.
segments.tr: - **The reason for layoff is written as "resigning".** Make sure the document reflects the actual condition.

segments.src: - **Melewatkan batas waktu klaim.** Catat tanggal efektif PHK dan hitung tenggat pengajuan.
segments.tr: - **Missing the claim deadline.** Note the effective date of the layoff and calculate the submission deadline.

segments.src: - **Data tidak cocok.** Perbedaan nama, NIK, atau nomor rekening antara data BPJS dan dokumen sering menjadi penyebab klaim tertahan.
segments.tr: - **Mismatched data.** Differences in name, NIK, or account number between BPJS data and documents are often the cause of delayed claims.

segments.src: - **Mencairkan JHT tanpa rencana.** Dana yang habis cepat membuat pekerja kehilangan bantalan di masa pensiun.
segments.tr: - **Disbursing JHT without a plan.** Funds running out quickly make workers lose a cushion in retirement.

segments.src: - **Tidak mengikuti pelatihan atau informasi pasar kerja.** Dua manfaat ini juga hak Anda dan bisa mempercepat peluang bekerja kembali.
segments.tr: - **Not following training or labor market information.** These two benefits are also your rights and can accelerate employment opportunities.

segments.src: ## Daftar Periksa Singkat Saat Menghadapi PHK
segments.tr: ## Short Checklist When Facing Layoffs

segments.src: 1. Minta surat PHK tertulis dan simpan salinannya.
segments.tr: 1. Request a written layoff letter and keep a copy.

segments.src: 2. Catat tanggal efektif PHK serta alasan yang tercantum.
segments.tr: 2. Note the effective date of the layoff and the listed reason.

segments.src: 3. Hitung perkiraan pesangon dan hak lain, lalu minta rincian dari perusahaan.
segments.tr: 3. Calculate estimated severance and other rights, then ask for a breakdown from the company.

segments.src: 4. Cek status kepesertaan BPJS Ketenagakerjaan (JKP dan JHT).
segments.tr: 4. Check BPJS Ketenagakerjaan membership status (JKP and JHT).

segments.src: 5. Ajukan klaim JKP sesegera mungkin dalam batas waktu.
segments.tr: 5. File a JKP claim as soon as possible within the deadline.

segments.src: 6. Putuskan pencairan JHT dengan mempertimbangkan kebutuhan jangka panjang.
segments.tr: 6. Decide on JHT disbursement by considering long-term needs.

segments.src: 7. Siapkan anggaran darurat dan mulai mencari peluang kerja atau pelatihan baru.
segments.tr: 7. Prepare an emergency budget and start looking for new job opportunities or training.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: PHK memang berat, tetapi pekerja tidak sepenuhnya tanpa perlindungan.
segments.tr: Layoffs are tough, but workers are not completely without protection.

segments.src: Memahami perbedaan pesangon, JKP, dan JHT membantu Anda menyusun langkah dengan tenang dan menghindari hak yang terlewat.
segments.tr: Understanding the differences between severance pay, JKP, and JHT helps you plan steps calmly and avoid missed rights.

segments.src: Untuk kepastian, hubungi kanal resmi BPJS Ketenagakerjaan, dinas ketenagakerjaan setempat, atau konsultan hukum ketenagakerjaan sesuai kondisi Anda.
segments.tr: For certainty, contact official BPJS Ketenagakerjaan channels, the local manpower office, or a labor legal consultant according to your condition.

id-20261030-international-logistics-tran.title: [International Logistics and Transportation #8] Damaged Cargo on Board, Who Pays and How Much?

segments.src: > Saat barang rusak atau hilang di laut, perusahaan pelayaran tidak selalu wajib mengganti penuh. Seberapa besar tanggung jawabnya bergantung pada aturan yang berlaku: Hague-Visby, Hamburg, atau Rotterdam.
segments.tr: > When goods are damaged or lost at sea, the shipping company is not always required to pay full compensation. How large its liability is depends on the applicable rules: Hague-Visby, Hamburg, or Rotterdam.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Dalam pengangkutan laut, **pengangkut** (carrier, biasanya perusahaan pelayaran) menerima barang dari pengirim, lalu menerbitkan **bill of lading (B/L)** sebagai bukti penerimaan dan bukti kontrak pengangkutan.
segments.tr: In sea transport, the **carrier** (usually a shipping company) receives goods from the shipper and then issues a **bill of lading (B/L)** as proof of receipt and proof of the contract of carriage.

segments.src: Pertanyaan pentingnya: kalau barang rusak, hilang, atau terlambat, sejauh mana pengangkut harus bertanggung jawab?
segments.tr: The key question: if goods are damaged, lost, or delayed, to what extent must the carrier be liable?

segments.src: Sejak hampir seratus tahun lalu, dunia mencoba menjawabnya lewat konvensi internasional.
segments.tr: For almost a hundred years, the world has tried to answer this through international conventions.

segments.src: Ada tiga yang paling sering dibahas:
segments.tr: Three are discussed most often:

segments.src: Hague-Visby Rules (Hague Rules 1924, diubah Protokol Visby 1968)**
segments.tr: Hague-Visby Rules (Hague Rules 1924, amended by the Visby Protocol 1968)**

segments.src: Rezim yang paling banyak dipakai dan paling "ramah pengangkut".
segments.tr: The most widely used regime and the most "carrier-friendly" one.

segments.src: - Pengangkut wajib menyediakan kapal yang laik laut (*seaworthy*) dan merawat muatan dengan layak.
segments.tr: - The carrier must provide a seaworthy ship and properly care for the cargo.

segments.src: - Tapi ada daftar panjang pengecualian. Yang paling terkenal: pengangkut **tidak bertanggung jawab** atas kerusakan akibat kesalahan nakhoda/awak dalam *navigasi atau pengelolaan kapal* (nautical fault), serta akibat kebakaran, kecuali karena kesalahan pengangkut sendiri.
segments.tr: - But there is a long list of exceptions. The best known: the carrier is **not liable** for damage caused by errors of the master or crew in *navigating or managing the ship* (nautical fault), or for damage from fire, unless the fire was caused by the carrier's own fault.

segments.src: - Batas ganti rugi: **666,67 SDR per koli atau 2 SDR per kg berat kotor**, dipilih yang lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: - Compensation limit: **666.67 SDR per package or 2 SDR per kg gross weight**, whichever is higher.

segments.src: - Berlaku sejak barang dimuat ke kapal sampai dibongkar (*tackle to tackle*).
segments.tr: - Applies from when the goods are loaded onto the ship until they are discharged (*tackle to tackle*).

segments.src: - Gugatan harus diajukan dalam **1 tahun**.
segments.tr: - Claims must be filed within **1 year**.

segments.src: Hamburg Rules (1978, berlaku sejak 1992)**
segments.tr: Hamburg Rules (1978, in force since 1992)

segments.src: Lahir dari dorongan negara-negara berkembang yang merasa Hague terlalu menguntungkan pemilik kapal.
segments.tr: Born from the push of developing countries that felt the Hague Rules were too favorable to ship owners.

segments.src: - Pengangkut **dianggap bersalah** kecuali bisa membuktikan sudah mengambil semua langkah yang wajar.
segments.tr: - The carrier is **presumed at fault** unless it can prove it took all reasonable measures.

segments.src: - Pengecualian nautical fault **dihapus**.
segments.tr: - The nautical fault exception is **removed**.

segments.src: - Batas lebih tinggi: **835 SDR per koli atau 2,5 SDR per kg**.
segments.tr: - Higher limit: **835 SDR per package or 2.5 SDR per kg**.

segments.src: - Mengatur tanggung jawab atas **keterlambatan** (maksimal 2,5 kali ongkos angkut barang yang terlambat).
segments.tr: - Regulates liability for **delay** (maximum 2.5 times the freight for the delayed goods).

segments.src: - Berlaku dari pelabuhan ke pelabuhan (*port to port*); batas waktu gugatan **2 tahun**.
segments.tr: - Applies port to port; the claim deadline is **2 years**.

segments.src: - Kenyataannya, negara-negara pelayaran besar tidak ikut, sehingga pemakaiannya terbatas.
segments.tr: - In practice, major shipping nations did not join, so its use is limited.

segments.src: Rotterdam Rules (2008)**
segments.tr: Rotterdam Rules (2008)

segments.src: Upaya menyesuaikan hukum dengan era kontainer.
segments.tr: An effort to adapt the law to the container era.

segments.src: - Mencakup pengangkutan **door to door** selama ada bagian lautnya (*maritime plus*).
segments.tr: - Covers **door to door** carriage as long as there is a sea leg (*maritime plus*).

segments.src: - Batas: **875 SDR per koli atau 3 SDR per kg**.
segments.tr: - Limit: **875 SDR per package or 3 SDR per kg**.

segments.src: - Mengakui dokumen elektronik.
segments.tr: - Recognizes electronic documents.

segments.src: - Namun **belum berlaku** karena jumlah ratifikasinya belum mencapai 20 negara yang disyaratkan.
segments.tr: - However, it **is not yet in force** because the number of ratifications has not reached the 20 countries required.

segments.src: **SDR** (Special Drawing Rights) adalah satuan nilai buatan IMF yang dipakai agar batas ganti rugi tidak tergerus inflasi mata uang satu negara.
segments.tr: **SDR** (Special Drawing Rights) is a unit of value created by the IMF, used so that liability limits are not eroded by inflation in any single country's currency.

segments.src: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Life

segments.src: Bu Rina, eksportir mebel di Jepara, mengirim **10 peti meja jati** (total 2.000 kg) senilai **Rp300 juta** ke Rotterdam lewat Pelabuhan Tanjung Emas, Semarang.
segments.tr: Ms. Rina, a furniture exporter in Jepara, ships **10 crates of teak tables** (2,000 kg in total) worth **Rp300 million** to Rotterdam via Tanjung Emas Port in Semarang.

segments.src: B/L-nya memuat klausul yang memberlakukan Hague-Visby Rules.
segments.tr: The B/L contains a clause applying the Hague-Visby Rules.

segments.src: Di tengah jalan, air laut masuk ke kontainer karena seal pintu rusak, dan semua meja rusak.
segments.tr: Along the way, seawater got into the container because the door seal was damaged, and all the tables were ruined.

segments.src: Hitung batas ganti ruginya menurut Hague-Visby:
segments.tr: Calculate the compensation limit under Hague-Visby:

segments.src: Per koli : 10 peti x 666,67 SDR = 6.666,7 SDR
segments.tr: Per koli : 10 peti x 666,67 SDR = 6.666,7 SDR

segments.src: Per kg   : 2.000 kg x 2 SDR     = 4.000 SDR
segments.tr: Per kg   : 2.000 kg x 2 SDR     = 4.000 SDR

segments.src: Dipakai yang lebih tinggi        = 6.666,7 SDR
segments.tr: Dipakai yang lebih tinggi        = 6.666,7 SDR

segments.src: Dengan asumsi 1 SDR sekitar Rp22 ribu (kurs berubah-ubah), Bu Rina maksimal hanya bisa menuntut sekitar **Rp147 juta**, kurang dari setengah nilai barangnya.
segments.tr: Assuming 1 SDR is about Rp22 thousand (the exchange rate fluctuates), Ms. Rina can claim at most about **Rp147 million**, less than half the value of the goods.

segments.src: Itu pun kalau pengangkut terbukti bertanggung jawab.
segments.tr: And that is only if the carrier is proven liable.

segments.src: Pelajarannya ada dua.
segments.tr: There are two lessons.

segments.src: Pertama, nilai barang bisa dicantumkan di B/L (*declared value*) agar batas tidak berlaku, biasanya dengan ongkos angkut lebih mahal.
segments.tr: First, the value of the goods can be stated on the B/L (*declared value*) so the limit does not apply, usually at a higher freight cost.

segments.src: Kedua, yang lebih umum, **asuransi kargo**.
segments.tr: Second, and more common, **cargo insurance**.

segments.src: Perlu diketahui juga, Indonesia bukan negara pihak pada ketiga konvensi ini.
segments.tr: It is also worth knowing that Indonesia is not a party to any of these three conventions.

segments.src: Dalam praktik, aturannya sering berlaku karena dimasukkan lewat klausul di B/L (*clause paramount*) atau karena hukum negara tujuan.
segments.tr: In practice, the rules often apply anyway, because they are incorporated through a B/L clause (*clause paramount*) or because of the law of the destination country.

segments.src: ## 3 Poin Penting
segments.tr: ## 3 Key Points

segments.src: 1. Tanggung jawab pengangkut laut dibatasi, bukan ganti rugi penuh. Besarnya bergantung pada rezim yang berlaku.
segments.tr: 1. A carrier's liability for sea transport is limited, not full compensation. The amount depends on the applicable regime.

segments.src: 2. Hague-Visby paling luas dipakai dan paling melindungi pengangkut. Hamburg lebih melindungi pemilik barang. Rotterdam paling modern (door to door) tapi belum berlaku.
segments.tr: 2. Hague-Visby is the most widely used and protects the carrier the most. Hamburg protects the cargo owner more. Rotterdam is the most modern (door to door) but is not yet in force.

segments.src: 3. Cara melindungi diri: cek klausul B/L, pertimbangkan declared value, dan selalu gunakan asuransi kargo.
segments.tr: 3. How to protect yourself: check the B/L clauses, consider declared value, and always use cargo insurance.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.tr: **1.** Under the Hague-Visby Rules, the carrier remains liable for damage caused by the master's error in navigating the ship.

segments.tr: **2.** Which regime covers door-to-door carriage as long as there is a sea leg?

segments.tr: a) Hague-Visby Rules

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Bill of lading (B/L)**: dokumen dari pengangkut sebagai tanda terima barang, bukti kontrak angkut, dan dokumen kepemilikan.
segments.tr: - **Bill of lading (B/L)**: a document issued by the carrier as a receipt for goods, evidence of the contract of carriage, and a document of title.

segments.src: - **Nautical fault**: kesalahan awak kapal dalam navigasi atau pengelolaan kapal; dikecualikan dari tanggung jawab di Hague-Visby.
segments.tr: - **Nautical fault**: an error by the ship's crew in navigating or managing the ship; excluded from liability under Hague-Visby.

segments.src: - **Batas tanggung jawab (limitation of liability)**: jumlah maksimal ganti rugi yang bisa dituntut dari pengangkut.
segments.tr: - **Limitation of liability**: the maximum amount of compensation that can be claimed from the carrier.

segments.src: - **SDR (Special Drawing Rights)**: satuan nilai dari IMF yang dipakai untuk menetapkan batas ganti rugi.
segments.tr: - **SDR (Special Drawing Rights)**: a unit of value from the IMF used to set liability limits.

segments.src: - **Clause paramount**: klausul di B/L yang menetapkan konvensi mana yang mengatur kontrak pengangkutan.
segments.tr: - **Clause paramount**: a B/L clause that specifies which convention governs the contract of carriage.

segments.tr: Hague-Visby actually exempts the carrier from errors in navigating and managing the ship (nautical fault); the Hamburg Rules are the ones that remove this exception.

segments.src: Rotterdam Rules dirancang untuk pengangkutan "maritime plus" yang mencakup darat sebelum dan sesudah laut.
segments.tr: The Rotterdam Rules are designed for "maritime plus" carriage that covers land transport before and after the sea leg.

id-20261030-news-1.title: Government Debt and State Budget (APBN) Interest Burden 2027: How to Read the Debt Ratio, SBN Yields, and State Spending Space

segments.src: Setiap kali pembahasan anggaran negara dimulai, satu angka hampir selalu muncul lebih dulu: rasio utang terhadap produk domestik bruto (PDB).
segments.tr: Whenever a discussion on the state budget begins, one figure almost always appears first: the debt-to-gross domestic product (GDP) ratio.

segments.src: Angka itu sering dipakai sebagai "vonis" tunggal.
segments.tr: That figure is often used as a single "verdict".

segments.src: Jika masih di bawah batas, keuangan negara dianggap aman.
segments.tr: If it is still below the limit, state finances are considered safe.

segments.src: Jika naik, muncul kekhawatiran.
segments.tr: If it rises, concerns arise.

segments.src: Padahal rasio utang hanya salah satu potret, dan potret itu bisa menyesatkan bila dibaca sendirian.
segments.tr: In fact, the debt ratio is only one snapshot, and that snapshot can be misleading if read alone.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara membaca rasio utang dengan lebih utuh, bagaimana bunga utang menggerus ruang belanja dalam Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN), dan indikator lain yang layak dipantau, termasuk dalam pembahasan APBN 2027.
segments.tr: This article explains how to read the debt ratio more holistically, how debt interest erodes spending space in the State Budget (APBN), and other indicators worth monitoring, including in the discussion of the 2027 APBN.

segments.src: > Catatan: artikel ini bersifat edukasi dan bukan saran investasi atau kebijakan. Angka yang disebut bersifat ilustratif atau berupa kisaran umum. Untuk data terbaru, rujuk dokumen resmi seperti Nota Keuangan, laporan APBN KiTa, dan publikasi Kementerian Keuangan serta Bank Indonesia.
segments.tr: > Note: this article is educational and not investment or policy advice. The figures mentioned are illustrative or in the form of general ranges. For the latest data, refer to official documents such as the Financial Note (Nota Keuangan), APBN KiTa reports, and publications by the Ministry of Finance and Bank Indonesia.

segments.src: ## Apa Arti Rasio Utang terhadap PDB
segments.tr: ## What the Debt-to-GDP Ratio Means

segments.src: Rasio utang dihitung dengan membagi posisi utang pemerintah dengan PDB, lalu dinyatakan dalam persen.
segments.tr: The debt ratio is calculated by dividing the government's debt position by GDP, then expressing it as a percentage.

segments.src: PDB dipakai sebagai pembanding karena mewakili ukuran ekonomi, yaitu kemampuan negara menghasilkan pendapatan dari pajak dan sumber lain.
segments.tr: GDP is used as a comparator because it represents the size of the economy, namely the country's ability to generate revenue from taxes and other sources.

segments.src: Di Indonesia, Undang-Undang Keuangan Negara menetapkan batas rasio utang pemerintah sebesar 60 persen dari PDB, dan defisit anggaran maksimal 3 persen dari PDB.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, the State Finance Law sets a government debt ratio limit of 60 percent of GDP, and a maximum budget deficit of 3 percent of GDP.

segments.src: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir rasio utang Indonesia berada jauh di bawah batas itu, jauh lebih rendah daripada banyak negara maju maupun sejumlah negara berkembang sebaya.
segments.tr: In recent years, Indonesia's debt ratio has been well below that limit, much lower than many developed countries and several peer developing nations.

segments.src: Namun, angka ini punya keterbatasan:
segments.tr: However, this figure has limitations:

segments.src: - **Tidak menunjukkan beban bayar.** Rasio yang rendah tidak otomatis berarti cicilan dan bunga ringan.
segments.tr: - **Does not show the payment burden.** A low ratio does not automatically mean light installments and interest.

segments.src: - **Tidak membedakan jenis utang.** Utang berbunga murah berjangka panjang jauh berbeda dengan utang berbunga tinggi berjangka pendek.
segments.tr: - **Does not distinguish the type of debt.** Low-interest, long-term debt is very different from high-interest, short-term debt.

segments.src: - **Bergantung pada penyebut.** Rasio bisa turun bukan karena utang berkurang, melainkan karena PDB nominal tumbuh. Sebaliknya, perlambatan ekonomi bisa mendorong rasio naik tanpa utang baru.
segments.tr: - **Depends on the denominator.** The ratio can fall not because debt decreases, but because nominal GDP grows. Conversely, an economic slowdown can push the ratio up without new debt.

segments.src: - **Tidak mencerminkan kapasitas pendapatan.** Negara dengan penerimaan pajak kecil terhadap PDB lebih rentan daripada negara dengan rasio utang sama tetapi penerimaan lebih besar.
segments.tr: - **Does not reflect revenue capacity.** Countries with small tax revenues relative to GDP are more vulnerable than countries with the same debt ratio but larger revenues.

segments.src: ## Bunga Utang: Belanja yang Tidak Bisa Ditawar
segments.tr: ## Debt Interest: Non-Negotiable Spending

segments.src: Dalam APBN, pembayaran bunga utang masuk sebagai bagian belanja pemerintah pusat.
segments.tr: In the APBN, debt interest payments are included as part of central government spending.

segments.src: Sifatnya wajib: pemerintah harus membayarnya tepat waktu agar kredibilitas tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: Their nature is mandatory: the government must pay them on time to maintain credibility.

segments.src: Artinya, bunga utang adalah belanja yang tidak bisa ditunda seperti proyek tertentu.
segments.tr: This means debt interest is spending that cannot be postponed like certain projects.

segments.src: Akibatnya, makin besar porsi bunga, makin kecil ruang untuk belanja lain.
segments.tr: As a result, the larger the interest portion, the smaller the room for other spending.

segments.src: Bayangkan penghasilan rumah tangga: jika cicilan dan bunga pinjaman memakan bagian yang semakin besar dari gaji, sisa untuk kebutuhan lain, tabungan, dan investasi ikut menyempit.
segments.tr: Imagine household income: if loan installments and interest consume an increasingly large part of the salary, the remainder for other needs, savings, and investment shrinks accordingly.

segments.src: Logika yang sama berlaku pada anggaran negara, meski skalanya jauh berbeda.
segments.tr: The same logic applies to the state budget, even though the scale is very different.

segments.src: Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, pembayaran bunga utang dalam APBN berada pada kisaran ratusan triliun rupiah per tahun, dan porsinya terhadap belanja maupun terhadap pendapatan negara menjadi perhatian banyak analis.
segments.tr: In recent years, debt interest payments in the APBN have been in the range of hundreds of rupiah trillions per year, and their portion of spending as well as state revenue has become a concern for many analysts.

segments.src: Tren ini wajar disorot karena menyangkut dua hal: besarnya utang yang menumpuk dari tahun ke tahun, dan tingkat bunga saat utang diterbitkan atau diperpanjang.
segments.tr: This trend is naturally highlighted because it concerns two things: the amount of debt accumulating from year to year, and the interest rate when debt is issued or rolled over.

segments.src: ## Imbal Hasil SBN dan Mengapa Ia Menentukan
segments.tr: ## SBN Yields and Why They Matter

segments.src: Sebagian besar utang pemerintah berbentuk Surat Berharga Negara (SBN), yaitu surat utang negara dan sukuk negara.
segments.tr: Most government debt is in the form of State Securities (SBN), namely state treasury notes and state sukuk.

segments.src: Imbal hasil (yield) SBN adalah tingkat bunga yang diminta investor untuk memegang surat tersebut.
segments.tr: SBN yield is the interest rate demanded by investors to hold those securities.

segments.src: Beberapa hal membuatnya penting:
segments.tr: Several things make it important:

segments.src: 1. **Penentu biaya utang baru.** Semakin tinggi yield saat lelang, semakin besar kupon yang harus dibayar pemerintah untuk utang yang baru diterbitkan.
segments.tr: 1. **Determinant of new debt cost.** The higher the yield at auction, the larger the coupon the government must pay for newly issued debt.

segments.src: 2. **Cerminan persepsi risiko.** Yield dipengaruhi suku bunga acuan, inflasi, nilai tukar, kondisi global, dan penilaian investor atas disiplin fiskal.
segments.tr: 2. **Reflection of risk perception.** Yield is influenced by benchmark interest rates, inflation, exchange rates, global conditions, and investor assessment of fiscal discipline.

segments.src: 3. **Dampak bertahap.** Perubahan yield tidak langsung mengubah seluruh beban bunga. Utang lama tetap memakai kupon lamanya. Dampaknya terasa pelan-pelan ketika utang jatuh tempo dan diperbarui dengan kupon yang baru.
segments.tr: 3. **Gradual impact.** Yield changes do not immediately change the entire interest burden. Old debt keeps its old coupon. The impact is felt slowly when debt matures and is renewed with a new coupon.

segments.src: Karena itu, memantau yield SBN tenor 10 tahun, yang sering dijadikan acuan, membantu publik memahami arah biaya pinjaman negara.
segments.tr: Therefore, monitoring 10-year SBN yields, which are often used as a benchmark, helps the public understand the direction of the country's borrowing costs.

segments.src: ## Risiko Refinancing dan Struktur Jatuh Tempo
segments.tr: ## Refinancing Risk and Maturity Structure

segments.src: Selain jumlah dan bunga, ada pertanyaan lain: kapan utang jatuh tempo?
segments.tr: Aside from amount and interest, there is another question: when does the debt mature?

segments.src: Jika banyak utang jatuh tempo pada waktu berdekatan, pemerintah harus menerbitkan utang baru dalam jumlah besar untuk melunasinya (refinancing).
segments.tr: If a lot of debt matures around the same time, the government must issue new debt in large amounts to pay it off (refinancing).

segments.src: Bila pada saat itu pasar sedang tidak bersahabat, biaya bisa naik.
segments.tr: If the market is unfavorable at that time, costs can rise.

segments.src: Karena itu, profil jatuh tempo yang tersebar dan rata-rata tenor yang cukup panjang dianggap lebih sehat.
segments.tr: Therefore, a spread-out maturity profile and a sufficiently long average tenor are considered healthier.

segments.src: Pengelola utang biasanya berupaya menjaga keseimbangan antara biaya rendah dan risiko yang terkendali.
segments.tr: Debt managers usually strive to maintain a balance between low costs and controlled risks.

segments.src: ## Indikator Selain Rasio Utang
segments.tr: ## Indicators Beyond the Debt Ratio

segments.src: Agar penilaian lebih utuh, ada beberapa indikator yang layak dilihat bersama rasio utang:
segments.tr: To make the assessment more complete, there are several indicators worth looking at alongside the debt ratio:

segments.src: - **Rasio bunga terhadap pendapatan negara.** Menunjukkan berapa bagian pendapatan yang tersedot untuk bunga. Banyak analis menganggap ini lebih informatif daripada rasio utang terhadap PDB.
segments.tr: - **Interest-to-state revenue ratio.** Shows what portion of revenue is sucked up by interest. Many analysts consider this more informative than the debt-to-GDP ratio.

segments.src: - **Rasio bunga terhadap belanja total.** Memperlihatkan seberapa besar bunga menyempitkan ruang belanja lain.
segments.tr: - **Interest-to-total spending ratio.** Shows how much interest narrows other spending space.

segments.src: - **Keseimbangan primer.** Selisih pendapatan dan belanja di luar bunga. Bila positif, pemerintah tidak perlu berutang untuk membiayai belanja di luar bunga. Bila negatif, sebagian utang baru dipakai untuk menutup belanja operasional dan program, bukan hanya bunga.
segments.tr: - **Primary balance.** The difference between revenue and spending excluding interest. If positive, the government does not need to borrow to finance non-interest spending. If negative, some new debt is used to cover operational spending and programs, not just interest.

segments.src: - **Defisit anggaran terhadap PDB.** Menunjukkan seberapa cepat utang bertambah.
segments.tr: - **Budget deficit to GDP.** Shows how fast debt is growing.

segments.src: - **Komposisi mata uang.** Porsi utang valuta asing membuat beban rupiah sensitif terhadap pergerakan kurs.
segments.tr: - **Currency composition.** The portion of foreign currency debt makes the rupiah burden sensitive to exchange rate movements.

segments.src: - **Kepemilikan SBN.** Porsi investor asing, perbankan, Bank Indonesia, dan investor ritel memengaruhi kerentanan terhadap gejolak pasar.
segments.tr: - **SBN ownership.** The portion of foreign investors, banking, Bank Indonesia, and retail investors affects vulnerability to market shocks.

segments.src: - **Rasio penerimaan pajak (tax ratio).** Menggambarkan kapasitas negara menghimpun pendapatan untuk membayar kewajiban.
segments.tr: - **Tax ratio.** Illustrates the country's capacity to collect revenue to pay obligations.

segments.src: - **Selisih pertumbuhan dan bunga.** Jika pertumbuhan ekonomi nominal lebih tinggi daripada rata-rata bunga utang, rasio utang cenderung lebih mudah dikendalikan. Jika sebaliknya, beban terasa lebih berat.
segments.tr: - **Growth-interest differential.** If nominal economic growth is higher than the average debt interest rate, the debt ratio tends to be easier to control. If otherwise, the burden feels heavier.

segments.src: ## Utang untuk Apa? Soal Kualitas Belanja
segments.tr: ## Debt for What? The Issue of Spending Quality

segments.src: Utang bukan dengan sendirinya buruk.
segments.tr: Debt is not inherently bad.

segments.src: Pembiayaan untuk infrastruktur, pendidikan, kesehatan, dan penguatan ekonomi dapat meningkatkan kapasitas produksi dan penerimaan di masa depan, sehingga utang itu "membayar dirinya sendiri".
segments.tr: Financing for infrastructure, education, health, and economic strengthening can increase production capacity and future revenues, so that the debt "pays for itself".

segments.src: Sebaliknya, utang yang terutama dipakai untuk belanja yang manfaat jangka panjangnya terbatas akan menyisakan beban tanpa tambahan kapasitas.
segments.tr: Conversely, debt used primarily for spending whose long-term benefits are limited will leave a burden without additional capacity.

segments.src: Pertanyaan yang relevan bagi publik bukan hanya "berapa utangnya", tetapi juga "untuk apa utang itu dipakai" dan "seberapa efektif belanjanya".
segments.tr: The relevant question for the public is not only "how much is the debt", but also "what is the debt used for" and "how effective is the spending".

segments.src: Kualitas belanja, ketepatan sasaran, dan transparansi pelaksanaan program ikut menentukan apakah utang produktif atau tidak.
segments.tr: Spending quality, target accuracy, and program implementation transparency help determine whether debt is productive or not.

segments.src: ## Ruang Fiskal dan Pembahasan APBN 2027
segments.tr: ## Fiscal Space and the 2027 APBN Discussion

segments.src: Ruang fiskal adalah bagian anggaran yang masih bisa digerakkan untuk prioritas baru setelah kewajiban yang sifatnya mengikat dipenuhi, seperti gaji, transfer ke daerah, subsidi, dan bunga.
segments.tr: Fiscal space is the part of the budget that can still be mobilized for new priorities after binding obligations are met, such as salaries, transfers to regions, subsidies, and interest.

segments.src: Dalam pembahasan APBN 2027, beberapa pertanyaan kunci berikut dapat membantu publik membaca dokumen anggaran:
segments.tr: In the discussion of the 2027 APBN, several key questions can help the public read the budget documents:

segments.src: 1. Berapa target defisit dan bagaimana kebutuhan pembiayaannya?
segments.tr: 1. What is the deficit target and how are the financing needs met?

segments.src: 2. Berapa alokasi pembayaran bunga, dan bagaimana porsinya terhadap pendapatan negara?
segments.tr: 2. What is the interest payment allocation, and how is its portion relative to state revenue?

segments.src: 3. Asumsi makro apa yang dipakai, misalnya pertumbuhan ekonomi, kurs, inflasi, dan yield SBN 10 tahun? Perubahan kecil pada asumsi ini bisa menggeser beban bunga.
segments.tr: 3. What macro assumptions are used, such as economic growth, exchange rate, inflation, and 10-year SBN yield? Small changes in these assumptions can shift the interest burden.

segments.src: 4. Seberapa realistis target penerimaan pajak dan penerimaan negara bukan pajak?
segments.tr: 4. How realistic are the tax revenue and non-tax state revenue targets?

segments.src: 5. Bagaimana rencana penerbitan SBN dan profil jatuh tempo ke depan?
segments.tr: 5. What is the SBN issuance plan and future maturity profile?

segments.src: 6. Berapa ruang tersisa untuk belanja prioritas seperti pendidikan, kesehatan, perlindungan sosial, dan infrastruktur?
segments.tr: 6. How much space remains for priority spending such as education, health, social protection, and infrastructure?

segments.src: Jawaban atas pertanyaan-pertanyaan ini biasanya tersedia dalam Nota Keuangan dan dokumen pendukung APBN.
segments.tr: Answers to these questions are usually available in the Financial Note and APBN supporting documents.

segments.src: Membandingkan beberapa tahun berturut-turut lebih berguna daripada melihat satu angka pada satu waktu.
segments.tr: Comparing several consecutive years is more useful than looking at a single figure at one time.

segments.src: ## Cara Praktis Membaca Berita tentang Utang
segments.tr: ## Practical Ways to Read News About Debt

segments.src: Ketika membaca judul berita tentang utang negara, beberapa kebiasaan berikut dapat membantu:
segments.tr: When reading news headlines about state debt, several of the following habits can help:

segments.src: - **Cek sumber angka.** Pastikan data berasal dari lembaga resmi dan perhatikan periodenya.
segments.tr: - **Check the source of the figures.** Make sure the data comes from official institutions and pay attention to the period.

segments.src: - **Bedakan nominal dan rasio.** Utang bisa naik secara nominal sementara rasionya stabil atau turun karena ekonomi tumbuh.
segments.tr: - **Distinguish nominal and ratio.** Debt can rise in nominal terms while its ratio is stable or falling because the economy is growing.

segments.src: - **Lihat konteks pembanding.** Bandingkan dengan negara sebaya, bukan hanya dengan negara yang struktur ekonominya sangat berbeda.
segments.tr: - **Look at comparative context.** Compare with peer countries, not just with countries whose economic structures are vastly different.

segments.src: - **Waspadai kesimpulan tunggal.** Frasa seperti "aman" atau "bahaya" sering terlalu menyederhanakan. Tanyakan indikator apa yang mendasarinya.
segments.tr: - **Beware of single conclusions.** Phrases like "safe" or "dangerous" often oversimplify. Ask what underlying indicators support them.

segments.src: - **Perhatikan tren, bukan satu titik.** Arah perubahan beban bunga selama beberapa tahun lebih bermakna daripada angka satu tahun.
segments.tr: - **Pay attention to trends, not a single point.** The direction of change in the interest burden over several years is more meaningful than a single year's figure.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Rasio utang terhadap PDB tetap berguna sebagai titik awal, tetapi tidak cukup untuk menilai sehat atau tidaknya keuangan negara.
segments.tr: The debt-to-GDP ratio remains useful as a starting point, but it is not enough to assess whether state finances are healthy or not.

segments.src: Gambaran yang lebih lengkap muncul ketika rasio itu dibaca bersama beban bunga terhadap pendapatan, keseimbangan primer, imbal hasil SBN, struktur jatuh tempo, komposisi mata uang, dan kualitas belanja.
segments.tr: A more complete picture emerges when that ratio is read alongside the interest-to-revenue burden, primary balance, SBN yields, maturity structure, currency composition, and spending quality.

segments.src: Bagi warga biasa, memahami indikator-indikator ini membuat diskusi anggaran lebih jernih: bukan sekadar menakutkan atau menenangkan, melainkan berbasis data.
segments.tr: For ordinary citizens, understanding these indicators makes budget discussions clearer: not merely frightening or reassuring, but data-driven.

segments.src: Dengan begitu, perdebatan tentang APBN 2027 dapat berfokus pada hal yang paling penting, yaitu bagaimana negara membiayai kebutuhannya secara berkelanjutan sambil tetap menyisakan ruang untuk belanja yang bermanfaat bagi masyarakat.
segments.tr: That way, the debate on the 2027 APBN can focus on what matters most, namely how the state finances its needs sustainably while still leaving room for spending that benefits the public.
